div.p: Like strings of a harpsichord descending from the void, true loyalty binds two hands around the same hilt. Anyone can pledge fealty during the banquet; only the faithful remain when the world forbids the vow and the road leads into the dark.
A knight without romance is merely a mercenary; it is the promise kept in the sanctuary that turns cold steel into a sacred calling. Come siege, famine, or exile, the sworn covenant stands unbroken.

g.text: LOYALTY UNTO DEATH : HONOR BEFORE CROWNS
